    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        if (deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index === this.currentSlide) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER BADGE
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            right: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ACCENT TAG
           =========================================== */
        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            padding: clamp(0.15rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-radius: 4px;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-blue));
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.6vh, 8px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-dim);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-teal-glow);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(91, 141, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text-primary) 0%, var(--accent-teal) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .title-authors {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .title-authors strong {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .title-tagline {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            max-width: 600px;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM MOTIVATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .problem-slide h2 {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .ram-comparison {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            max-width: min(95vw, 850px);
        }

        .ram-bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .ram-bar {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
            min-height: 8px;
            transition: height 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }

        .ram-bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .ram-bar-name {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .ram-bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            position: absolute;
            top: -1.5em;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .problem-bullets {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .problem-bullets li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding-left: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .problem-bullets li::before {
            content: '▸';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--accent-coral);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        .arch-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .arch-pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
            max-width: 100%;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .arch-stage {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }

        .arch-stage:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-teal-glow);
        }

        .arch-stage-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .arch-stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.1rem, 0.2vh, 0.2rem);
        }

        .arch-stage-desc {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .arch-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .arch-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: COMPUTE ALLOCATION
           =========================================== */
        .compute-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .compute-comparison {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .compute-config {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .compute-config.winner {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-surface), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.05));
        }

        .compute-config-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .compute-config-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .compute-config-result {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: clamp(0.1rem, 0.3vw, 0.2rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .compute-config.winner .compute-config-result {
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .compute-config.loser .compute-config-result {
            background: rgba(255, 123, 114, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-coral);
        }

        .compute-bars {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: clamp(2rem, 4vh, 3rem);
        }

        .compute-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .compute-bar.encoder { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .compute-bar.lm { background: var(--accent-purple); }

        .compute-bar-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .compute-finding {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            padding-left: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .compute-finding strong {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: TOKEN COMPRESSION
           =========================================== */
        .token-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .pixel-shuffle-demo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .ps-grid-container {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .ps-grid {
            display: grid;
            gap: 2px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .ps-grid.input-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, clamp(18px, 3vw, 36px));
            grid-template-rows: repeat(4, clamp(18px, 3vw, 36px));
        }

        .ps-grid.output-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(1, clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 50px));
            grid-template-rows: repeat(1, clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 50px));
        }

        .ps-cell {
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .ps-cell:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }

        .ps-grid-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .ps-arrow-section {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .ps-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .ps-arrow-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .output-cell-content {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .shuffle-comparison {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 700px);
        }

        .shuffle-option {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .shuffle-option.recommended {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-surface), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.05));
        }

        .shuffle-r {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .shuffle-option.recommended .shuffle-r {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .shuffle-reduction {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .shuffle-note {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.25rem);
        }

        .token-finding {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            padding-left: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .token-finding strong { color: var(--accent-teal); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: CONTEXT LENGTH SCALING
           =========================================== */
        .context-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .context-cards {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .context-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .context-card-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .context-card-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.3vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .context-card-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .context-card-body code {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.9);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
            padding: 0.1em 0.3em;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .context-scale {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .context-scale-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .context-scale-bar {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-radius: 5px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .context-scale-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-teal));
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .context-scale-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: BENCHMARK TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .bench-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .bench-table-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(95vw, 920px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
        }

        .bench-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bench-table th:first-child,
        .bench-table th:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
        }

        .bench-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.15rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .bench-table td:first-child {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-weight: 500;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
        }

        .bench-table td:nth-child(2) {
            text-align: left;
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
        }

        .bench-table tr.avg-row td {
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
            border-bottom: none;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            padding-top: clamp(0.25rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .bench-table .best-cell {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .bench-ram-row {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            align-items: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            max-width: min(95vw, 920px);
        }

        .bench-ram-chip {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vw, 0.25rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.7vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .bench-ram-chip.highlight {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
        }

        .bench-ram-chip.warning {
            border-color: var(--accent-coral);
            background: rgba(255, 123, 114, 0.08);
        }

        .bench-ram-chip .chip-label { color: var(--text-secondary); }
        .bench-ram-chip .chip-value { font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-primary); }
        .bench-ram-chip.highlight .chip-value { color: var(--accent-teal); }
        .bench-ram-chip.warning .chip-value { color: var(--accent-coral); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 8: ON-DEVICE DEPLOYMENT
           =========================================== */
        .deploy-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .deploy-metrics {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .deploy-metric-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .deploy-metric-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3.5vw, 2.8rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .deploy-metric-unit {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: clamp(0.1rem, 0.2vh, 0.2rem);
        }

        .deploy-metric-context {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-top: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .deploy-throughput-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);

         SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
         =========================================== -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        if (deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index === this.currentSlide) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        if (deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index === this.currentSlide) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

            --content-gap: clamp(0.5rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            --element-gap: clamp(0.25rem, 1vw, 1rem);

            --ease-out-expo: cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            --duration-normal: 0.6s;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           RESET & BASE
           =========================================== */
        *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        /* ===========================================
           VIEWPORT FITTING: MANDATORY BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        html, body { height: 100%; overflow-x: hidden; }
        html { scroll-snap-type: y mandatory; scroll-behavior: smooth; }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list { gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem); }
        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li { font-size: var(--body-size); line-height: 1.4; }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative { display: none; }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root { --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem); }
            .grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GLOBAL STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.5;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
        }

        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            line-height: 1.15;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           GRID BACKGROUND PATTERN
           =========================================== */
        .slide::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE NUMBER BADGE
           =========================================== */
        .slide-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            right: clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(24px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: scale(0.92);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo), transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-scale {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: scale(1);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ACCENT TAG
           =========================================== */
        .tag {
            display: inline-block;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-accent);
            padding: clamp(0.15rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem) clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            border-radius: 4px;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PROGRESS BAR
           =========================================== */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-teal), var(--accent-blue));
            width: 0%;
            z-index: 9999;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           NAV DOTS
           =========================================== */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(0.75rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(4px, 0.6vh, 8px);
            z-index: 9998;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.5vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--text-dim);
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
            padding: 0;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent-teal);
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-teal-glow);
            transform: scale(1.3);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 1: TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            text-align: center;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 70%, rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(91, 141, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
                var(--bg-primary);
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 900px);
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 5vw, 3.6rem);
            font-weight: 800;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--text-primary) 0%, var(--accent-teal) 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            background-clip: text;
        }

        .title-authors {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-weight: 400;
        }

        .title-authors strong {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .title-tagline {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            max-width: 600px;
            line-height: 1.5;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 2: PROBLEM MOTIVATION
           =========================================== */
        .problem-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
        }

        .problem-slide h2 {
            font-size: var(--h2-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .ram-comparison {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            padding: clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 12px;
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            max-width: min(95vw, 850px);
        }

        .ram-bar-group {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
            flex: 1;
        }

        .ram-bar {
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0;
            min-height: 8px;
            transition: height 0.8s var(--ease-out-expo);
            position: relative;
        }

        .ram-bar-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            text-align: center;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .ram-bar-name {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            text-overflow: ellipsis;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .ram-bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            position: absolute;
            top: -1.5em;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .problem-bullets {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .problem-bullets li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding-left: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            position: relative;
        }

        .problem-bullets li::before {
            content: '▸';
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            color: var(--accent-coral);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 3: ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW
           =========================================== */
        .arch-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .arch-pipeline {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            flex-wrap: nowrap;
            max-width: 100%;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        .arch-stage {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            text-align: center;
            transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
        }

        .arch-stage:hover {
            border-color: var(--border-accent);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-teal-glow);
        }

        .arch-stage-icon {
            font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .arch-stage-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.1rem, 0.2vh, 0.2rem);
        }

        .arch-stage-desc {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.3;
        }

        .arch-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .arch-note {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            text-align: center;
            font-style: italic;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 4: COMPUTE ALLOCATION
           =========================================== */
        .compute-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .compute-comparison {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1rem);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .compute-config {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .compute-config.winner {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-surface), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.05));
        }

        .compute-config-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .compute-config-label {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .compute-config-result {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            padding: clamp(0.1rem, 0.3vw, 0.2rem) clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vw, 0.6rem);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        .compute-config.winner .compute-config-result {
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .compute-config.loser .compute-config-result {
            background: rgba(255, 123, 114, 0.1);
            color: var(--accent-coral);
        }

        .compute-bars {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            align-items: center;
            height: clamp(2rem, 4vh, 3rem);
        }

        .compute-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--bg-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
            transition: width 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .compute-bar.encoder { background: var(--accent-blue); }
        .compute-bar.lm { background: var(--accent-purple); }

        .compute-bar-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vw, 0.3rem);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 10px);
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .compute-finding {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            padding-left: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .compute-finding strong {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 5: TOKEN COMPRESSION
           =========================================== */
        .token-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vh, 1rem);
        }

        .pixel-shuffle-demo {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(0.8rem, 2.5vw, 2.5rem);
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1.5rem);
        }

        .ps-grid-container {
            text-align: center;
        }

        .ps-grid {
            display: grid;
            gap: 2px;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .ps-grid.input-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(4, clamp(18px, 3vw, 36px));
            grid-template-rows: repeat(4, clamp(18px, 3vw, 36px));
        }

        .ps-grid.output-grid {
            grid-template-columns: repeat(1, clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 50px));
            grid-template-rows: repeat(1, clamp(28px, 4.5vw, 50px));
        }

        .ps-cell {
            border-radius: 3px;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .ps-cell:hover { transform: scale(1.1); }

        .ps-grid-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .ps-arrow-section {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .ps-arrow {
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .ps-arrow-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .output-cell-content {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .shuffle-comparison {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            max-width: min(90vw, 700px);
        }

        .shuffle-option {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            text-align: center;
        }

        .shuffle-option.recommended {
            border-color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bg-surface), rgba(0, 212, 170, 0.05));
        }

        .shuffle-r {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .shuffle-option.recommended .shuffle-r {
            color: var(--accent-teal);
        }

        .shuffle-reduction {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .shuffle-note {
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            margin-top: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.25rem);
        }

        .token-finding {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-teal);
            padding-left: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
        }

        .token-finding strong { color: var(--accent-teal); }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 6: CONTEXT LENGTH SCALING
           =========================================== */
        .context-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.5vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .context-cards {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .context-card {
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .context-card-number {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 500;
        }

        .context-card-title {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-size: clamp(0.8rem, 1.3vw, 1.1rem);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            line-height: 1.2;
        }

        .context-card-body {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .context-card-body code {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: calc(var(--small-size) * 0.9);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            background: var(--accent-teal-glow);
            padding: 0.1em 0.3em;
            border-radius: 3px;
        }

        .context-scale {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vw, 0.8rem);
            background: var(--bg-surface);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: clamp(0.5rem, 1.2vw, 1rem) clamp(0.8rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border: 1px solid var(--border-subtle);
            max-width: min(95vw, 800px);
        }

        .context-scale-label {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .context-scale-bar {
            flex: 1;
            height: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            background: var(--bg-elevated);
            border-radius: 5px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        .context-scale-fill {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: 5px;
            background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent-blue), var(--accent-teal));
            transition: width 1.2s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .context-scale-value {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent-teal);
            font-weight: 600;
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE 7: BENCHMARK TABLE
           =========================================== */
        .bench-slide .slide-content {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .bench-table-wrapper {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: min(95vw, 920px);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .bench-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: separate;
            border-spacing: 0;
            font-size: var(--tiny-size);
        }

        .bench-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-mono);
            font-weight: 600;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            padding: clamp(0.2rem, 0.5vw, 0.4rem) clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vw, 0.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border-accent);
            white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .bench-table th:first-child,
        .bench-table th:nth-child(2) {

    <!-- ===========================================
         SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
         =========================================== -->
    <script>
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.isScrolling = false;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
                this.setupWheelNav();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const idx = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            if (idx !== -1) {
                                this.currentSlide = idx;
                                this.updateProgressBar();
                                this.updateNavDots();
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    switch(e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                        case ' ':
                        case 'PageDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                        case 'PageUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                            break;
                        case 'Home':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(0);
                            break;
                        case 'End':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            this.goToSlide(this.slides.length - 1);
                            break;
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let touchStartY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
                    touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
                }, { passive: true });

                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const deltaY = touchStartY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(deltaY) > 50) {
                        if (deltaY > 0) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            setupWheelNav() {
                let wheelTimeout;
                document.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
                    if (this.isScrolling) return;
                    clearTimeout(wheelTimeout);
                    wheelTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                        if (e.deltaY > 30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.slides.length - 1));
                        } else if (e.deltaY < -30) {
                            this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                        }
                    }, 50);
                }, { passive: true });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                if (index === this.currentSlide) return;
                this.isScrolling = true;
                this.currentSlide = index;
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
                this.updateProgressBar();
                this.updateNavDots();
                setTimeout(() => { this.isScrolling = false; }, 800);
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                if (!this.progressBar) return;
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.slides.length) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const nav = document.getElementById('navDots');
                if (!nav) return;
                this.slides.forEach((_, i) => {
                    const dot = document.createElement('button');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.setAttribute('aria-label', `Go to slide ${i + 1}`);
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    nav.appendChild(dot);
                });
                this.navDotElements = nav.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                if (!this.navDotElements) return;
                this.navDotElements.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            new SlidePresentation();
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
